question.text: Applicable GST rate on Management Fees of a Cat III AIF (outside IFSC) is:

explanation.text: The Logic: GST on management fees is 18%, charged over and above stated fee % (Topic 5 reference). The Trap: Other rates don't apply to fund management services. Cross-Exam Context: Standard GST on financial services (except IFSC). Distributor's Pro-Tip: Always quote fees incl. 18% GST in client communications.
